mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the revised rule on fresh Wednesday cases was most worthwhile: a different timing conflict showed how human review could help without blocking ordinary trips.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the talkbox button was straightforward and less engaging than testing the routing rule, though the tactile access detail had a clear purpose.

surprise.text: The Tuesday test exposed a real two-carrier pickup that the rule wrongly refused because it could book only one volunteer.

arbitrary.text: Connecting the finished handset to the routing rule was not obvious to me until I inspected it, although the resulting shared queue made sense.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the community uses the dispatch system; the unexpected test failure and practical human handoff made the story engaging.
